Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Kelar Veshar: 37-year-old man, 153 cm (very-short), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-2-light. Face: broad oval face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette ochre-cream. Visible personal details: a carved belt buckle; a repaired cuff with bright thread; a shallow cheek scar. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: weight settles into one heel, shoulders square, hands relaxed and completely visible. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
